# Structure Beautification Algorithm (SBA)


The SBA method  can be found in the published articles"**Accelerating structure relaxation in chemically disordered materials with a chemistry-driven model**." *NPJ Computational Materials* 11.1(2025). 

**1.Extraction of Chemical Microenvironments**

The **submol_standard.py** and **analysis-sumol.py** scripts are then employed to extract the chemical microenvironments (atomic
coordination environments) from a series of POSCAR structures. Place these two
scripts together in the "**xx_POSCAR**" folder.

![](data:image/png;base64,)

To obtain the
microenvironment details for each structure, execute the following command:

**python submol_standard.py > 1.txt**

Note: this system’s
"rcut" value in the script is set to 5.0 (typically representing the
interatomic distance), it can be adjusted based on the specific requirements of
the microenvironment. Chemical microenvironment structures are named using the
format "**submol_xx**". **Jmol** software can be used to
visualize these structures of microenvironments. The
TXT file records the structures corresponding to each chemical
microenvironment, indicating which structures contain the specific type of
microenvironment.

![](C:\Users\28422\AppData\Roaming\marktext\images\2026-07-30-21-12-24-image.png)

2.  **Classification and Representative structure Generation**

The **analysis-sumol.py** script is
then used to read the **1.txt** file from the previous step and classify the
microenvironments based on their types. Run the command:

**python analysis-sumol.py**

we will obtain an **output.csv** file. The first column of this file lists all microenvironments along with
their corresponding "**submol_xx**" microenvironments, while the
second column contains the "**POSCAR_xx**" structures that include
those microenvironments. These "**POSCAR_xx**" structures can be
used as the training set, as they cover all chemical microenvironments and
their structural characteristics. For example, in the BCC/Fe32C4_cell224_POSCAR2
folder, we should select **POSCAR_10_Fe32C4, POSCAR_11_Fe32C4, POSCAR_13_Fe32C4,POSCAR_14_Fe32C4,POSCAR_45_Fe32C4** as the representative structures.
